svg.title: A hazy city summer sky: a flat sky-light field with five soft cloud banks, stepping to cloud-base and cloud-light in the last 70 rows. PALER THAN EVERY OTHER LEVEL ON PURPOSE - Ottawa is a deep cold winter blue, Quebec City a pale winter haze over snow, Halifax a bright maritime blue over grey timber, and this one is a bleached August afternoon over asphalt. Both band steps are at world y 890 and 925, behind the opaque haze band at the foot of layer-20-skyline, which starts at world 880 and is the one layer guaranteed beside this one at the low preset - so no hard step can ever show against open sky. World y 0..960; clouds are kept inside x 120..960 so the extreme columns stay flat band colour for the desktop side panel.
